scenes.heading: Solving two-step equations
scenes.sub: Keep it balanced, get x on its own
scenes.say: Four x plus seven equals thirty-five. Two things have happened to x. In this video you'll learn a neat way to undo both and find x.
scenes.caption: 4x + 7 = 35. Two things have happened to x. In this video you'll learn a neat way to undo both and find x.

scenes.heading: Think of it like this
scenes.everyday: A level see-saw stays level if both friends add the same bag
scenes.science: Do the same operation to both sides and the equation stays true
scenes.breaks: on a see-saw you only add or remove weight; with equations you can also multiply or divide both sides.
scenes.say: Imagine a level see-saw. If one friend picks up a five kilogram bag, it tips, unless the other friend picks one up too. Equations work the same way: do the same thing to both sides and they stay balanced.

scenes.heading: The method
points: Do the same thing to BOTH sides
scenes.say: Here's the method. Whatever you do, do it to both sides. First remove the number being added or subtracted. Then undo the multiply or divide. Line up your equals signs, and check your answer.

scenes.heading: Worked example
scenes.question: Solve 6x − 11 = 13.
scenes.say: Solve six x minus eleven equals thirteen. Add eleven to both sides: six x equals twenty-four. Divide both sides by six: x equals four. Check: twenty-four minus eleven is thirteen.
scenes.caption: Solve 6x − 11 = 13. Add 11 to both sides: 6x = 24. Divide both sides by 6: x = 4. Check: 24 − 11 = 13.

scenes.heading: Dividing x
scenes.question: Solve x/5 + 2 = 9.
scenes.say: Solve x over five plus two equals nine. Subtract two from both sides: x over five equals seven. Multiply both sides by five: x equals thirty-five.
scenes.caption: Solve x/5 + 2 = 9. Subtract 2 from both sides: x/5 = 7. Multiply both sides by 5: x = 35.

scenes.heading: A negative answer
scenes.question: Solve 3x + 14 = 2.
scenes.say: Answers can be negative. Three x plus fourteen equals two. Subtract fourteen: three x equals negative twelve. Divide by three: x equals negative four.
scenes.caption: Answers can be negative. 3x + 14 = 2. Subtract 14: 3x = −12. Divide by 3: x = −4.

points: Answers can be negative or fractions
scenes.say: Quick recap. Keep the equation balanced, remove the plus or minus number first, then the times or divide, and always check. Now try the practice questions!
